results.name: Guilt Aversion
results.description: This contrast compares trials in which participants matched expectations (i.e., reciprocated the amount they believed their partner expected) to trials in which they returned less than they believe their partner expected at the decision phase epoch.  This contrast compares trials in which the guilt model predicts guilt aversion and guilt inaversion. Guilt inaversion trials by definition are when players make more money and thus are associated with increased financial value.  Images are thresholded using cluster correction p < 0.05 with an initial z threshold of 2.3.
results.contrast_definition: matching expectations vs returning less than players believe their partner expected

results.name: Pre-pump vs. Pre-cashout Searchlight Classification Results
results.description:
Searchlight map with classification accuracy for discriminating between pre-cashout and pre-pump trials matched for risk level. Thresholded at accuracy > 60%; cluster-corrected to p < .05.

This map is the result from an MVPA searchlight analyses classifying stat maps as being from pre-pump or pre-cashout trials. The value at each voxel represents the % accuracy classification using a searchlight centered at that voxel.
results.contrast_definition: classification accuracy in identifying beta series as coming from trials preceding a pump or trials preceding a cashout

results.cognitive_contrast_cogatlas: pre-cash trials minus pre-pump trials matched for risk level
results.name: Pre-cashout vs. pre-pump
results.description:
Contrast between trials preceding cashout trials and trials preceding pump trials in the BART (trials matched for level of risk)

This contrast is contrasting trials immediately preceding a cashout vs. trials immediately preceding a pump. However, the pre-pump condition only contains a subset of all the pre-pump trials for that participant that are matched to the risk level of that participant's pre-cashout trials. So both the pre-pump and pre-cashout regressor would include 3 trials from pump #3, 5 trials from pump #4, 2 trials from pump #5, and so on.
results.contrast_definition: pre-cash trials minus pre-pump trials with risk level matched
